warped_gate.worst: 192000 Hz, highshelf, 20 Hz corner, Q 0.1, +24 dB, lambda -0.9999, legacy route
warped_gate.reference: Independent prewarped analog polynomials, bilinear substitution and direct-form-I state. For standard bilinear families, allpass A=(z^-1-lambda)/(1-lambda*z^-1) multiplies (1-z^-1)/(1+z^-1) by (1+lambda)/(1-lambda), exactly the factor applied to the prototype prewarp. Their static physical transfers therefore coincide with the original analog target. No production Warped/Biquad processing/coefficient helpers used.

warped_gate.test_policy: Explicit #[ignore] required audit gate, separate from 11 historical ignored captures. Invoke by name with -- --ignored --nocapture. EQ cannot be marked complete until it passes. No tolerance or accepted range changed.
warped_gate.next_action: Investigate cancellation in tiny warped prototype frequency coefficients and the implicit feedback solve at negative lambda endpoint. Preserve mathematically specified response, accepted range, recursive history and transactional rate-change behavior when correcting it.

kautz_retained_host_rates.frequency_q_weight_geometries: Same endpoints and four geometries as standalone matrix.
kautz_retained_host_rates.warm_input: 512 source frames with +0.25 impulse; RateDoubler yields 1024 old-rate frames
kautz_retained_host_rates.post_rebuild_input: 1024 new-rate frames with -0.125 impulse at frame 7
kautz_retained_host_rates.history_policy: Both routes rebuild modal history on host rate change. Warm and new-rate audio compared to separate independent modal models.
kautz_retained_host_rates.fixture_limitation: RateDoubler duplicates frames and declares 2x rate; removing it tests retained-node host rate domains and history, not a physical sample-rate converter.

kautz_reference: Independent real-pole coefficients r=min(exp(-pi*f/(Q*fs)),0.9999), theta=2*pi*f/fs. Each basis is (1-r^2)^(3/2)/(1-2*r*cos(theta)*z^-1+r^2*z^-2), preceded by product of earlier second-order allpasses. Independent DF-I recurrence, signed linear weighted sum and dry path. Denominator Jury margins checked. Runtime TDF-II state/helpers are not reused. This is the documented fixed-pole modal basis, not a complete two-function orthonormal Kautz pair.
